name: hukuhaka-engineering-plan
description: Resolve engineering contracts, dependencies, and uncertainty with repository-grounded plans, then resume authorized implementation.

interface.longDescription: Resolve contracts and cross-component dependencies, specify exact changes, challenge invariants, and select reusable verification evidence. Planning-only requests end with a plan; implementation requests return to execution.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $engineering-plan to produce a repository-grounded, decision-complete implementation plan.
